title: SA, NSW - Upgrade the Network
current_summary:
Parts of NSW and SA. Maintenance window 12:30 AM–6:00 AM AEDT on 8 October 2026, with short interruptions around 1:00 AM, 1:30 AM and 2:30 AM (15–30 minutes).

This deployment is part of a program to both improve Fixed Wireless performance through faster speed tiers and to install Small Wireless Routers (SWR) at Fixed Wireless sites. It supports the shift from Long Term Evolution (LTE) to 5G to enable faster speed tiers as demand grows and boosts network resilience with better failover paths, helping reduce outages and avoid capacity issues. Installing SWRs at Fixed Wireless sites will help reduce customer impact during scheduled and unscheduled network outages because of its ability to route traffic via alternate fibre/microwave paths. In addition to this, the SWR also supports the load balancing of traffic. This planned outage is to change the network over to the newly installed SWR and activate its new features.

updates.content:
One of our network partners will be performing planned upgrades that will affect some Fixed Wireless services in parts of NSW and SA.

When: 12:30 AM–6:00 AM AEDT on 8 October 2026.
Expected impact: brief loss of internet connectivity during the window, with short outages planned around 1:00 AM, 1:30 AM and 2:30 AM AEDT (15–30 minutes each).

What we’re doing: We’re monitoring the work and will help restore services as each interruption completes.

If available, you can use mobile data during brief interruptions. We appreciate your patience.
The planned maintenance window has commenced. Short interruptions are expected as scheduled, with work due to finish by 6:00 AM AEDT on 8 October 2026.
